title: Death Is Not One Thing
description: Close this expedition with two further native milestones: defeat a Wraith and establish the Coffin craft milestone. Ghosts, persistent souls, undead bodies, resurrection, and Lifeforce remain distinct REIGN concepts even when one mod places several of them beside one another.
description_completed: The Graveyard expedition is complete without collapsing REIGN's distinct death and soul mechanics into a single occult resource.
